events.content:
Implemented the reading tracker. It shows current and finished books, lets you add a title, author, and notes, and provides a detail page with a shareable link. Opening or refreshing a `/book/<id>` link loads that book directly.

The app stores books in `data/books.json`, creates the file on first run, and keeps it out of Git so your notes stay local.

Run it with `npm start`, then open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000). I didn’t run tests.

Key files: [server.mjs](/workspace/server.mjs), [public/app.js](/workspace/public/app.js), [public/styles.css](/workspace/public/styles.css), [README.md](/workspace/README.md).
